results.title: path.strokeBounds on path with single segment and stroke color
results.evidence: Gleam Butt stroke of an empty subpath returns an empty path; bounds then returns EmptyPath. Paper returns the item position as a zero-size rectangle.

results.title: path.strokeBounds on closed path with single segment and stroke color
results.evidence: Independent source-cubic extrema and closure-miter calculation agree with Paper. Independent polynomial bounds of the returned outline agree with Gleam within 5.7e-14. Default max edge error is 0.00120330, falling to 0.00012666 at fitting tolerance 0.002/0.001. Smaller tested tolerances hit the supported depth-5 refinement limit. See first-stroke-bounds-findings.json.

results.title: path.strokeBounds with corners and miter limit
results.evidence: Independent source extrema and accepted miter references agree with unrounded Paper bounds within 5.7e-14. Independent polynomial bounds of the returned outline agree with Gleam within 1.8e-13. Successful sweep edge errors are below the requested fitting tolerance; tighter requests eventually reach the supported refinement limit. See remaining-stroke-bounds-findings.json.
